settings.title: How to use it
settings.content: Pull a fresh sheet. Wash like you always do. Pat dry — don't rub. Toss it: it's 100% bamboo fiber and biodegrades in months.

settings.title: Is one sheet really enough?
settings.content: Yes. Each sheet is thick, ultra-absorbent, and sized for a full face-dry. One wash, one sheet, done — no damp towel hanging around collecting bacteria until laundry day.

settings.title: How fast is delivery?
settings.content: Ships within 24 hours anywhere in the UAE. Free delivery over Dhs 100. Cash on delivery available everywhere.

settings.title: What if my skin disagrees?
settings.content: Start with the Travel size — Dhs 19. One pack, one week, see what your skin says. Lowest-risk glow-up in the store.

settings.combo_sub: Travel for your bag, XL for your sink. Your future self says thanks.
settings.review_quote: "The first towel that didn't leave my cheeks red. Noticed it in week one."
